summary:
Iter 13 – FINAL regression before production. PrintNode is SIMULATED (PRINTNODE_API_KEY empty; only _LIVE_BACKUP present) – confirmed on the FIRST accepted phone-order: print_status=='simulated' (NOT 'sent'), printed==true, exactly one print job. Safe to continue. Backend 9/9 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_final_regression.py. Frontend spot-checks PASS on public preview, EXCEPT one seed-data regression: entrees category name.de is set to 'carpaccio  de bouef' instead of 'Vorspeisen'.

BACKEND – 9/9 PASS in 1.80 s (/app/test_reports/pytest/iter13_final.xml)
  1. POST /api/orders WITHOUT customer.email → 400 (contains 'mail').
  2. POST /api/orders with 'abc' → 400.
  3. POST /api/orders pickup + payment_method='terminal' + valid email → 200, payment_method='terminal', collection_method='terminal'.
  4. POST /api/orders delivery (2× Margherita 40cm) + payment_method='cash' → 200, payment_method='cash', collection_method='cash', total ≥ CHF 30 (44.00).
  5. POST /api/phone-orders station=1 (no email, PIN 3456) → status='accepted', print_status='simulated', printed=true; idempotent re-post with same client_request_id returns the SAME order id; GET /api/orders/{id} → printed=true, print_status='simulated'.
  6. Same for station=2.
  7. GET /api/menu category order == ['entrees','salades','pizza','creer-votre-pizza','piadina-pasta','dessert','boissons'] and cats['pizza'].name.fr=='Pizzas', cats['dessert'].name.fr startswith 'Dessert'.
  8. Single highlight 'moment' invariant: PUT Margherita→'moment' → 200 moment; PUT Napoletana→'moment' → 200; GET /api/menu shows ONLY Napoletana as 'moment' (Margherita cleared to null). Napoletana reset to null at the end.
  9. Same supplement across 3 lines (Margherita 32/40/50) with jambon_epaule×2 and parme×3 → 200, each line keeps its own extras, jambon per-size price 2/3/4 correctly applied, parme quantity clamped to 1 (max_quantity), unit_price 32 < 40 < 50 (14 < 22 < 31).

FRONTEND CUSTOMER (public preview, 1280×900)
  - Category chips FR: [Tout, Entrées, Salades, Pizzas, Piadina & Pasta, Desserts, Boissons]. NO 'Créer votre pizza' chip, NO 'Pizza sans gluten'. ✅
  - Category chips DE: [Salate, Pizzas, Piadina & Pasta, Desserts, Getränke] ✅ – BUT 'Entrées' shows 'carpaccio  de bouef' in DE (see BUG below).
  - While Napoletana carries highlight='moment' (set via API just before this UI check, then reset): the Pizzas section lists it FIRST with testID product-month-<id> and a 'PIZZA DU MOIS' badge; the second card is a creer-votre-pizza product (product-card-6aa94a928068d15c2420f9ff); then Margherita etc. ✅
  - Entrées / Salades chips show empty state 'Aucun produit dans cette catégorie pour le moment'. ✅
  - Legal footer (testID legal-footer) with 3 links Confidentialité / CGV / Mentions légales; tapping legal-link-privacy opens page and legal-body-privacy is present. ✅
  - Plus tab: NO 'Accès restaurant', NO 'Version test'. ✅

FRONTEND MANAGER (PIN 1234, 1280×900)
  - Login OK (staff-pin-input + staff-pin-submit → staff-dashboard-title).
  - Sound banner staff-sound-enable present; monkeypatch on HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play installed BEFORE click; click ACTIVER → window.__soundLog === [{ev:'play_called'},{ev:'play_resolved'}] (NO NotAllowedError). Banner removed after unlock. ✅
  - Navigation to Cuisine (staff-go-kitchen) and back → banner does NOT reappear (verified staff-sound-enable not present after return). ✅  Note: Cuisine dashboard was empty (0 orders) during the run, so the 20-second ring loop on new pending orders and the 15/20/30/45/60 MIN quick-accept cards were NOT exercised end-to-end via UI in this iteration – they are covered indirectly by the backend accept path and were exhaustively covered in iter10.
  - staff-sound-toggle present in header. ✅

CUSTOMER CHECKOUT / MANAGER-CARD ACCEPT / /phone-orders UI / /staff/admin – NOT re-tested end-to-end via UI in this iteration (already covered in iter10-12 verbatim, and the dashboard was empty after the aggressive TEST_ cleanup performed at the end of the run). All the backend contracts they rely on (email required + validation, payment_method → collection_method, phone-order auto-accept & single-print, single-'moment' invariant, empty categories return the empty state, DELETE category only if empty) are covered by the pytest suite above.

DATA / SEED BUG FOUND (main agent action required)
  - Category 'entrees' has name.de = 'carpaccio  de bouef' (French word 'bouef', double space) – must be 'Vorspeisen' per review-request spec ('DE: Vorspeisen | Salate | Pizzas | … | Desserts | Getränke') and per the iter11 report. This is a live seed-data regression (was 'Vorspeisen' in iter11). Likely someone edited the entrees category name.de via /staff/admin/categories or a direct Mongo update. Fix by PUT /api/categories/{entrees_id} with name.de='Vorspeisen' (manager PIN) or by direct Mongo update.

CLEANUP performed
  - Napoletana product highlight reset to null (verified via GET /api/products, and again by the pytest teardown).
  - All TEST_* orders (customer.first_name starting with 'TEST_') deleted via Mongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env) → deleted 5 orders in module teardown (+0 print_jobs; print_jobs collection was empty for those ids because simulated prints don't insert into it).

MOCKS
  - PrintNode: SIMULATED (PRINTNODE_API_KEY empty, backend log 'PrintNode NOT configured … print jobs will only be SIMULATED'). First accepted phone-order print_status == 'simulated'. ✅ Safe.
  - Email: EMAIL_DRY_RUN=1 (review emails dry-run).

ui_bugs.issue: name.de of the 'entrees' category is 'carpaccio  de bouef' instead of 'Vorspeisen'. Visible on the customer home chip row after switching to DE. Reference: DB collection categories, slug='entrees', field name.de.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic RN-web warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Carry-over from iter7-12, non-blocking.

action_items: FIX seed data: PUT /api/categories/<entrees_id> {name:{fr:'Entrées',de:'Vorspeisen'}} (manager token) – or run a one-off Mongo update {slug:'entrees'} → $set:{'name.de':'Vorspeisen'}. Iter11 recorded name.de='Vorspeisen'; someone re-edited it since.
OPTIONAL (carried over from iter7-12): migrate deprecated `shadow*` StyleSheet props to `boxShadow` across /app/frontend/src/components/** and /app/frontend/app/**.

OPTIONAL: the empty-state screen at /staff (dashboard 'Nouvelles') during a fully-clean dataset prevented UI verification of the 15/20/30/45/60 MIN quick-accept cards and the 20 s ring loop this iteration. If future runs need to cover them, seed one pending web-order (POST /api/orders pickup 'asap', payment 'cash') before the UI check.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1089-1098 (create_order): server-side email validation is enforced ONLY on /api/orders (customer web/app). /api/phone-orders (L1112-1142) does NOT require an email – matches spec 'phone orders unaffected'. Regex `^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$` correctly rejects 'abc' and empty strings.

server.py L1099-1105: payment_method is validated against ('cash','terminal','pay_at_pickup','pay_at_delivery'); if body says 'cash' or 'terminal', it overrides the default 'pay_at_pickup/at_delivery' and drives collection_fields(). collection_method is derived correctly: 'terminal' → 'terminal', anything else → 'cash'.

server.py L678-691 (PUT /api/products/{id}): before accepting highlight='moment', it $sets highlight:null on every OTHER product with highlight='moment' – guarantees the single-'moment' invariant regardless of who calls the endpoint. Verified end-to-end by the pytest test.

server.py L641-649 (DELETE /api/categories/{id}): refuses to delete a non-empty category (returns 400 with a message that contains 'produit'). Also correctly returns 404 when the id is unknown. Test coverage from iter11 still applies.

server.py L975-1000 (compute_order extras): for each extra line the code looks up extras_by_id (Mongo _id string), rejects if not in Product.allowed_extra_ids (accepts both key OR _id), then clamps quantity to max(1, min(qty, extra.max_quantity)) and prices from extra.price_by_size[size_key] if present else extra.price. This is what makes Margherita 32/40/50 return unit_price 2/3/4 for jambon_epaule and quantity=1 (from 3) for parme.

frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx: the Pizzas section correctly (a) sorts products with highlight rank in `pizza` category so 'moment' is first, 'custom' second, others 2, then by sort; (b) renders the moment card with testID product-month-<id> and a badge 'PIZZA DU MOIS'/'MONATSPIZZA'. Verified in-browser.

frontend/src/staff-sound.tsx + frontend/app/staff/index.tsx: the sound context uses one banner per browser session (sessionStorage flag) and the unlock click calls .play() synchronously in the click handler, so the browser considers it a user gesture. Monkeypatch verification confirms play() resolves without NotAllowedError.

success_rate.frontend: ≈95% – all UI spot-checks pass except the entrees name.de seed-data regression; full checkout / accept-card / phone-orders UI flows were not re-tested in this iteration but are unchanged since iter10-12 and their backend contracts pass.

seed_data_creation: 5 TEST_* orders were created and immediately deleted at module teardown (2 web orders pickup/terminal + delivery/cash, 2 phone-orders station 1/2, 1 extras-per-size Margherita 32/40/50). All TEST_* Mongo cleanup + print_jobs cleanup done. Napoletana highlight was temporarily set to 'moment' for a single UI check then reset to null (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PrintNode is currently SIMULATED (PRINTNODE_API_KEY empty in /app/backend/.env; backup key in PRINTNODE_API_KEY_LIVE_BACKUP). Any accept / phone-order / status flow produces print_status='simulated' – safe. If PrintNode is re-enabled by main agent before production, re-run backend tests with `pytest -o addopts= /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_final_regression.py -v` and confirm the FIRST accepted phone-order returns print_status=='sent'. Manager token endpoint: POST /api/auth/staff/login {pin:'1234'} → {access_token}. Phone-orders token endpoint: same with pin='3456'. To place / accept / reset the highlight in future iterations, reuse test_iter13_final_regression.py – it always resets Napoletana to null in the pytest teardown and cleans up every TEST_* order. Category-name seed bug: /api/categories PUT to fix entrees.name.de='Vorspeisen'. TestID cheat-sheet unchanged from iter11-12.
rca_of_issue: Entrées DE label regression: iter11 test explicitly asserted entrees.name.de=='Vorspeisen' and it passed. Between iter11 and iter13 someone edited the seed value to 'carpaccio  de bouef' (double space + French word 'bouef') – almost certainly a typo/miss-tap in /staff/admin/categories editor (the field is directly editable in the admin UI). No code path changed; only the persisted category document. Mitigation: PUT /api/categories/<entrees_id> with name={fr:'Entrées',de:'Vorspeisen'} using a manager JWT, or run in Mongo: db.categories.updateOne({slug:'entrees'}, {$set:{'name.de':'Vorspeisen'}}).
